paite: Huan Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad in asepaih tengteng akaikhawm vek a, kumpipa sawmthum-le-nih atel ua, sakol leh kangtalaite toh akuantou a, Samaria khua ava um a, adouta hi.
heading: Siria Toh Kidouna

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab kiang ah khopi sung ah mi asawl a, akiang ah, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi,
"Na dangka leh dangka-eng kei a ahi. Na zite leh na tate, na neih hoihpente tan in leng kei a ahi," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n ana dawng a, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, na gen bang in kei leh ka neih tengteng nang a ahi," achi hi.
Amisawlte apai nawn ua, Ben-hadad in hichi in achi, "Ka kiang a na dangka leh dangka-eng, na zite leh na tate na hon piak ding ahi, chi in mi hon sawl ding ka hi,
'Zingchiang hiai hun in ka sikhate na kiang ah ka hon sawl dia, na inn leh na sikhate inn ahong mai ding uh.' Huan hichi ahi ding a, na mit late ala ding ua, ahon paipih vek ding uh," achi hi.

Israel kumpipa'n agam a upa tengteng asam a, thei un, “Hiai mi in thil hoih loutak hih atupdan. Ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl a, ka zite, ka tate, ka dangka leh ka dangka-eng ahong ngen a, amah ka na nial kei hi," achi hi.
Upa tengteng leh mipi tengteng in akiang ah, "Amah na limsak dah inla, angette leng pe sam ke'n," achi uhi.

Ben-hadad misawlte kiang ah, "Kumpipa, ka toupa kiang ah, na sikha kiang a mi sawl a na hon nget masak tengteng bang in ka hih dia; himahleh hiai zaw ka hih kei ding," achi, chỉ un. Huchi in amisawlte apai nawn ua, huai thu ava tun uhi.
Ben-hadad in akiang ah mi asawl nawn a, "Kei hon zui teng in akhut dim ua apham dia kiching Samaria kho leivui nutsiat ahihleh pathiante'n alohloh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa'n adawng a, "Mi kigalthuam khinsa, agalvan suah khesa bang in ki-uangsak kei hen, chi in va hilh un,” achi hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, amah leh kumpipate'n puanin a zu ana dawnkhawm lai un huai thu Ben-hadad in ana za a, amite kiang ah, "Kisa dih ua," achi hi. Huchi in khua dou ding in akisata uhi.

Huchi in ngai in, zawlnei khat in Israel kumpipa Ahab ava naih a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai mipi tampite na mu hia? Ngai in, tu in na khut ah ka hon pe ding. Huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.

Ahab in, "Kua zang in eita?" achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte zang in," achi hi. Ama'n, “Kua'n dou dia thu pe ding eita?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Nangmah in,” chi in adawng hi.
Huchi in ama'n gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte akaikhawm a, zanih sawmthum-le-nih ahi uh. Huai mite nung in mi tengteng, Israel suan tengteng akaikhawm a, sangsagih ahi uh.
Sun laitak in ava pawt ua, Ben-hadad leh kumpipate, amah panpih kumpipa sawmthum-le-nihte huai puanin ah zu dawnkham in ana om uh.
Gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte ava pawt masa ua; Ben-hadad in mi asawl a, "Amau, Samaria a pan hong pawt a-om uh," chi in ahilh uh.
Ama'n, "Kilep tum a hong ahih uleh hingmat unla, kidou tum a hong ahih uleh leng hingmat un," achi hi.
Huchi in hiai gam sehkhente a heutu tangvalte leh ahon zui sepaihte khua a pan apawt uhi.
Abitum chiat uh ava that ua; huchi in Siriate ataikekta ua, Israelte'n adelh uhi. Huchi in Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad sakol tung a tuang in sakol tungtuang mite toh asuakta hi.
Israel kumpipa ava pawtkhia a, sakol leh kangtalaite ava sual a, Siriate tampi athat hi.
Zawlnei in Israel kumpipa ava naih a, akiang ah, "Kihatsak inla, na hihdan ding ngaihtuah in kum hong beileh Siria kumpipa'n hong dou nawn ding ahi," achi hi.
Siria kumpipa sikhate'n akiang ah, "Apathiante uh mualte pathiante ahi uh. Huaiziak a ei sang a amau hatzaw ahi uh. Phaizang ah dou lehang, amau sang ini hatzaw ngeingei ding uh," achi uhi.
heading: Siria Hong Dou Nihveina

paite: "Hiai thilhih in, kumpipate avek un lakhia inla, amun uah gamuk mite koih in.

Sepaihte, sakolte leh kangtalaite, na mansuahsa zah geih sepaihte ding khethaksak nawn in. Huchi in phaizang ah i dou ding ua, amau sang in i hatzaw na ding uhi,” achi uh. Ama'n athugen uh angaikhia a, huchibang in ahihta hi.
Akum nawn in hichi ahong hi a, Ben-hadad in Siriate akaikhawm a, Israelte dou ding in Aphek ah ahohtou hi.
Israel suante leng akikaikhawm ua, nek ding asekkhawm masa ua, dou ding in akisata uhi. Israel suante kelnou tawm chikchik hon nih bang lel in ava kilang ua; Siriate bel gam ah apumdim uhi.

Pathian mipa'n Israel kumpipa va naih in, ahoupih a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Siriate'n, TOUPA mualte Pathian ahi a, phaizang Pathian ahi kei, achi uhi. Huaiziak in hiai mipi tampite na khut ah ka hon pe ding hi, huchi in kei TOUPA ka hi, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
Ni sagih sungtak akinangtuah nilouh uh. Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in akidouta ua; Israel suante'n Siria mite ni khat in sepaih nuaikhat athat uhi.
Midangte bel Aphek ah, khopi sung ah atailut ua, omlaite mi singnih-le-sangsagih kulh chim in achipkhumta hi. Ben-hadad atai a, khopi sung ah dantan sunggil ah alut hi.

Asikhate'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, Israel inkuan lak a kumpipate mihehpih thei kumpipate ahi uh chih thu ka za uh. Sai-ip puan teng in, ka lu ua khau a kikhih in Israel kumpipa kiang ah hon va hohsak in; ama'n ahon hinghawi nuam khamoh kei ding," achi uhi.

Huchi in sai-ip puan ateng ua, alu uah khau in akikhih ua, Israel kumpipa kiang ah ava hoh ua, "Na sikha Ben-hadad in, hehpih in hon hinghawi hen, achi," achi uhi. Ama'n, "Dam lai ahi maw? Amah ka unaupa ahi," achi hi.

Huai mite'n lungnuamtak in, alungsim thutak gen ahi ding chih gingta in, "Na unaupa Ben-hadad himah e," achi pah uhi. Huchi in ama'n, "Va pai unla, hon pi un," achi hi. Ben-hadad ahong pawtkhia a, akiang ah ahoh a; ama'n akangtalai ah ana tuangsak hi.

Ben-hadad in akiang ah, “Ka pa'n na pa a pan khua ana lakte ka hon pekik ding. Ka pa'n Samaria a sumsinna munte a bawl bang in Damaskas ah sumsinna munte na bawl sam ding hi. Huchibang a thu kikhung in ka hon paisak ding hi," achi hi. Huchi in akiang ah thu akhung a, apaisakta hi.
Zawlnei tapate lak a mi khat in TOUPA thu in alawmpa kiang ah, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen ut kei hi.
heading: Zawlnei In Ahab Amohpaih

paite: Huchi in akiang ah, "TOUPA thu na man louh ziak in, ngai in, mual na hon khupsantak in, humpinelkai in ahon na kei ding," achi hi. Mual akhuptak in humpinelkai in atuak a, athat hi.
Huchi in midang ava mu nawn a, "Hon khen in," achi a; huai mi in akhen a, aliamta hi.
Huchi in zawlnei apai a, lampi ah kumpipa ana tang a, amai a vut nuh in ana kibawl lamdang hi.

Kumpipa ahong tun in kumpipa ana sam a, "Kei na sikha kidouna lak ah ka tailut a; ngai in, mi khat ahong kilehhei a, ka kiang ah mi khat ahon pi a, hiai mi na veng in, ataimangleh ahinna sik in na hinna na tan dia, ahihkeileh dangka talent khat na piak ding ahi," achi hi.
"Kei na sikha ka pumbuai ziak in ana paimangta hi," achi hi. Israel kumpipa'n akiang ah, "Huchibang geih in na tung a thu khen ahi ding, nangmah in thu khen khin na hi ve," achi hi.
Ama'n amai a pan vut alakhezok a; Israel kumpipa'n zawlneite lak a mi ahi chih atheita hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hihsiatgawp dia ka sehsa mi khat na paisak ziak in ahinna sik in nang hinna, amite sik in na mite na tan ding," achi hi.
Israel kumpipa bel nguitak leh lungkim loutak in apai a, Samaria khua ahong tungta hi.
